_comment: Citations for the Fall Back move and Desperate Escape Test core rules (10e). Wahapedia source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/

simulator.fall_back.quoted_text: If you make a Fall Back move with a unit, then until the end of the turn that unit's models cannot shoot or declare a charge.
simulator.fall_back.trigger: owning player's Movement phase; unit is within Engagement Range (1.5" in SwegHammer's continuous model) of one or more enemy units and makes a Fall Back move
simulator.fall_back.effect: unit moves up to M" away, may move through enemy models, and until the end of the turn cannot shoot or declare a charge - there is NO FLY exception (the 9th-edition 'may shoot/charge if it can FLY' carve-out was removed; current 10e locks out EVERY unit that Falls Back). FLY only affects HOW the Fall Back move is made: per the FLY keyword (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/core-rules/#FLY-keyword) 'If a model can FLY, when it makes a Fall Back move it can move over other models (excluding TITANIC models) as if they were not there, and when it Falls Back it does not have to take Desperate Escape tests' - it does not lift the shoot/charge lockout (see simulator.desperate_escape for the FLY/TITANIC Desperate Escape exemption). SwegHammer sets a per-round fell_back_this_round flag on the unit and gates _do_shoot / _do_charge on the flag alone (no FLY check).

simulator.desperate_escape.quoted_text: models can move over enemy models when making a Fall Back move as if those enemy models were not there, but you must take a Desperate Escape test for each model that will do so (excluding models that are TITANIC or can FLY). For each roll of 1-2, one model from the unit that is Falling Back is destroyed.
simulator.desperate_escape.trigger: immediately after a Fall Back move that passed through one or more enemy models; TITANIC and FLY models are entirely exempt
simulator.desperate_escape.effect: roll 1D6 per non-TITANIC non-FLY model in the falling-back unit; each result of 1-2 destroys one model. SwegHammer models units as one Unit per model, so a single D6 is rolled and on a 1-2 the unit's current_health is zeroed (one model destroyed). TITANIC or FLY units skip the test entirely.
